statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45591 (GHSA-f8h2-vmm9-qhj6) is an ASP.NET Core denial of service issue in the MessagePack hub protocol used by SignalR and Blazor Server: deeply nested MessagePack arrays cause a stack overflow. Microsoft lists the ASP.NET Core 9.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, and Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Protocols.MessagePack as affected from 9.0.0 through 9.0.16 and fixed in 9.0.17 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f8h2-vmm9-qhj6, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/405, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.17/9.0.17.md). The fix patches the bundled MessagePack reader so it no longer skips nested values recursively (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/commit/5edf41b9c09952f18e404ad38e25670991c1b513). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. No package contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Protocols.MessagePack.dll or its nupkg. The affected code ships in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server.dll, which holds the Blazor Server MessagePack hub protocol and its MessagePack reader. Implementation copies are in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework carried by aspnetcore9-runtime and by the .NET SDK in dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap, and in the ASP.NET Core runtime pack nupkg that dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap also holds, and each carries the build's own .NET version; the other copies, in aspnetcore9-targeting-pack, dotnet9-runtime-artifacts and the SDK's reference pack, are reference assemblies with no implementation code. The copies in the first 5 builds (9.0.12-r0 to 9.0.16-r0) still contain the recursive TrySkipNextArray and TrySkipNextMap routines that the fix removes; from 9.0.17-r0 on no copy contains them. The range ends at 9.0.17-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
